title: Instant search
detail: Products, prices, discounts and a category suggestion appear as you type, with 'view all (100+)'.

title: PC finder
detail: 'What are you looking for?' narrows gaming PCs by processor, memory, storage and graphics card.

title: Spec-rich listings
detail: Nine filters including motherboard and OS, sort by price, and CPU/RAM/storage/GPU lines on every card.

title: Detailed spec table
detail: Striped rows naming component brands (Patriot Viper DDR5, ASUS Dual RTX 3050, Gigabyte H610M, Xigmatek 700W).

title: Sticky buy bar
detail: Thumbnail, title, price and Add to Cart stay in view while reading specs.

title: Warranty up front
detail: '24 Months Warranty by Golden Tech' is the first thing under the price.

title: Guest checkout and pickup
detail: 'You can create an account after checkout', a map location picker and 'Pickup from store'.

title: Free-shipping progress
detail: The cart celebrates free shipping with a progress bar.

title: Local payments
detail: mada, Visa, Mastercard, Tabby, Tamara and card instalments; a 5% mada offer.

title: Compliance basics
detail: CR, VAT number, VAT badge and Saudi Business Center logo in the footer; the new Riyal symbol on every price.

title: Full Arabic store
detail: A complete right-to-left store view with correctly mirrored header, menus and carousels.

title: Off-site reputation
detail: 4.5–4.8 ratings on arabplaces, Cybo and magicpin from hundreds of reviews.
